Priya Persona Bible v1 for salary, behavior, fixed obligations, annual bonus, work pattern, household context, and annual vehicle/insurance obligations
Priya Account Universe v1 for visible accounts, rails, product mechanics, account ownership, credit card behavior, loan, SIP, RD, NPS, liquid fund, and insurance products

global_month_plan_guardrails: Do not create transactions.
Do not create raw AA payload.
Do not create daily sequence.
Do not create exact dated merchant lines.
Do not create account balances or monthly closing balances.
Do not reinterpret the locked Year Arc.
Use catalog_item_ids as references only; do not force catalog coverage.
Most months must remain boring or controlled; do not turn boring months into active months.
Do not add rare events or stress months beyond the Year Arc.
Priya cannot use BNPL or pay-later.
Priya cannot revolve credit card; HDFC Regalia must be paid in full every month.

Protected obligations continue every month: rent, education loan EMI, family support, father medicines support, staff payments, SIPs, RD, NPS, utilities, card full payment, and selected insurance obligations.
Priya may feel constrained, but protected obligations must not be missed.
Liquid fund redemption is allowed only in September 2025 stress context and never for routine lifestyle.
Liquid fund purchase or replenishment is allowed only in April 2026 planned bonus allocation context.
April bonus is planned allocation, not rescue or lifestyle inflation.
Medical claim reimbursement must lag after September medical payment and must not be same-day rescue.
Self-transfers are visible routing movements, not income or spending.
Family transfers are external UPI/IMPS/NEFT flows, not owned accounts.
Card purchases post to HDFC Regalia card first; deposit impact happens only when card bill is paid.
spend_envelope_interpretation_rule: Spend envelopes are non-additive planning bands for later day generation. They guide plausible gross outflows by category before reimbursements and must not be summed into a required monthly spend target.
aggregate_discretionary_cap_rule: Aggregate discretionary soft caps exclude salary, rent, staff payments, family support, father medicines support, utilities, annual insurance premiums, SIPs, RD, NPS, education loan EMI, credit card bill payment, self-transfers, reimbursements, liquid fund credits, and bonus inflow. Month/day generation should stay below the high end unless a selected Year Arc event explicitly explains the pressure.
credit_card_bill_payment_generation_rule: Monthly HDFC Regalia purchases post to the credit card first. Deposit impact occurs only when the full card bill is paid. The monthly protected recurring obligation aggregate excludes card bill payment. The Day/Ledger generator must derive the card bill payment from prior statement/cycle logic or starting-state carryover, not from spend_envelopes or selected_contexts.
selected_context_band_interpretation_rul: selected_contexts_for_day_generation amount bands overlap with spend_envelopes and selected_rare_or_pressure_events. They are planning constraints, not additional spend targets. If the same underlying need appears in recurring obligations, selected contexts, and selected rare/pressure events, generate it once using the source-of-truth rule.
annual_premium_generation_rule: Known annual insurance premiums may appear in known_recurring_obligations_plan, selected_contexts_for_day_generation, and selected_rare_or_pressure_events for planning visibility. The Day/Ledger generator must generate each annual premium once only, using known_recurring_obligations_plan as the source of truth. selected_rare_or_pressure_events should not create a second premium transaction.
medical_claim_timing_rule: The September medical event may create a later claim-reimbursement basis, but no reimbursement credit may be generated in September. October is the only selected reimbursement month, and the reimbursement must be credit-only, traceable to the September medical event, and not classified as salary or ordinary income.
protected_recurring_selected_context_rul: If a selected context includes protected recurring catalog IDs, those IDs are context markers only unless the context explicitly has generation_source: known_recurring_obligations_plan and do_not_generate_separately: true. Optional contexts should generally remove protected recurring IDs to avoid duplicate rent, staff, family-support, SIP, RD, NPS, utility, or milk transactions.
